text:
Not since the emergence of a certain Harry Kane has there been this much excitement about a player from Tottenham’s academy. On his first senior start, Luca Williams-Barnett showed just why as the 18-year-old became their youngest Premier League goalscorer since Gareth Bale in 2007 before teeing up Dominic Solanke with a mesmerising and matchwinning assist against Ipswich.
That made it four league victories from their last five matches for Roberto De Zerbi’s side and the Italian could only have enjoyed the view from the stands as he served his one-match touchline ban. Tottenham have struggled to match their London rivals Arsenal and Chelsea’s record of producing homegrown players in recent years but they appear to have struck gold with Williams-Barnett.
Harry Winks was the last academy graduate to score on his debut more than a decade ago – a feat that Kane also achieved two years earlier against Sunderland. Yet having decided to allow England Under 21 striker Will Lankshear to join Middlesbrough in the summer, there was no chance that Williams-Barnett would be allowed to follow him out of the door. He became the 900th player ever to represent them on his debut last year and the teenager left the field here to a standing ovation that he will never forget.
De Zerbi dropped a huge hint beforehand that Williams-Barnett could finally be handed his opportunity to start after two impressive cameos against Crystal Palace and Leeds. “Maybe, maybe,” he said on Friday. “When I have to select the first XI, I don’t start from the age.” The absence of Sandro Tonali due to illness forced Spurs into a reshuffle in midfield as Matheus Fernandes was handed the holding role and Pedro Porro captained the side with Micky van de Ven only on the bench.
After a promising start to the campaign, Ipswich’s momentum had stalled before the international break with four games without a victory. But Gary O’Neil was encouraged early on as Julio Enciso found some space and Abdoul Ouattara forced Antonin Kinsky into a save at his near post. Solanke has struggled to fill the void left by Kane since joining from Bournemouth in 2024 but looked in determined mood and he was inches wide with a swivel and shot from inside the area. A driving run from Williams-Barnett had the home supporters off their feet, with Solanke again going close from the resulting corner. It then needed a timely block from the teenager to stop Ipswich breaking downfield.
His big moment arrived less than 60 seconds later. Porro’s ball to the back post should have been dealt with by Ouattara, only for a moment’s hesitation to allow Williams-Barnett to muscle in front of him and apply the finish with his knee. “He’s one of our own,” sang the Tottenham fans in delight as the television cameras panned to De Zerbi celebrating in his padded seat.
Mohammed Kudus was unfortunate to see his superb effort from a free-kick cannon off the inside of the post and away to safety. Williams-Barnett will be disappointed not to have scored his second just effort half-time when he miskicked inside the six yard box with the goal gaping. James Maddison was then denied by a brilliant save from Christian Walton and Williams-Barnett left the field looking very pleased with himself as he waved to someone in the crowd.
His smile grew even broader after Darnell Furlong was left bamboozled by a direct run down the left flank before delivering the ball on a plate for Solanke to score his first goal here since March. The defeat could have been worse for Ipswich had it not been for Walton and O’Neil will know they are in danger of being sucked into trouble if this winless run continues. There are no such concerns for Tottenham these days. Thanks to Williams-Barnett, their future looks much brighter than a few weeks ago.
digest_he:
טוטנהאם רשמה ניצחון ביתי מרשים על איפסוויץ' טאון בהנהגתו של הכישור הצעיר לוק ויליאמס-בארנט, שפתח בהרכב הראשון לראשונה בקריירה תחת המאמן רוברטו דה זרבי. השחקן בן ה-18 הפך לכובש הצעיר ביותר של המועדון בפרמייר ליג מאז גארת' בייל ב-2007, כאשר כבש את שער היתרון בדקה ה-15 מקרוב.

המחצית הראשונה כללה מספר מצבים מסוכנים של המארחים, כולל בעיטה חופשית נפלאה של מוחמד קודוס שפגעה בקורה. למרות ניסיונות מצד איפסוויץ' לחזור למשחק, ויליאמס-בארנט המשיך להציג יכולת נהדרת ובמחצית השנייה סיפק בישול נהדר לדומיניק סולאנקה, שהבקיע את השער השני והבטיח את הניצחון עבור התרנגולים.

הניצחון מעיד על מגמת השיפור של טוטנהאם בליגה ועל השתלבותם של שחקני אקדמיה מוכשרים בסגל הבוגר. מנגד, איפסוויץ' ממשיכה להסתבך בתחתית הטבלה לאחר רצף משחקים ללא ניצחון שמעמיד אותה בסכנת ירידה ממשית.
